chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Umar ibn Udhaynah, who said:

I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: When he reached the back of the Kaaba, when passing by the Stone, [he would say]: 'O Possessor of Favors and Grace and Benevolence and Generosity! Indeed my deed is weak, so multiply it for me and accept it from me. Indeed You are the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.'

key_terms.ظَهْرُ الْكَعْبَةِ: The back of the Kaaba (Hijr Ismail)

ai.seo_question: What is the specific supplication recited at the back of the Kaaba during Tawaf according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: This narration from *Al-Kafi* highlights the spiritual significance of the supplication recited at the Hijr Ismail (the back of the Kaaba), a location traditionally associated with the standing place of Prophet Ibrahim. Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) models a posture of humble reliance on divine generosity, acknowledging human frailty while invoking God’s attributes of *Al-Samīʿ* (The All-Hearing) and *AlʿAlīm* (The All-Knowing) to ensure the acceptance of imperfect deeds. This practice underscores the Shia emphasis on the interplay between ritual action and internal devotion during the circumambulation.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Umar Bin Azina who said,

‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying when he<sup>asws</sup> ended up to the back of the Kaaba where passing by the (Black) Stone: ‘O the One with the Favours, and the Leniency, and the Benevolence, and the Generosity! My<sup>asws</sup> deeds are weak, so Multiply these for me<sup>asws</sup>, and Accept these from me<sup>asws</sup>, You<sup>azwj</sup> are the Hearing, the Knowing’.
en.sarwar: 6. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from ‘Umar ibn ‘Udhaynah who has said the following: “

I heard abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, when reaching at the backside of al-Ka‘bah after passing the Black Stone, say, ‘O Possessor of munificence, generosity and kindness, my deeds are weak, so increase them and accept them from me; You are all-Hearing and all-Knowing/”
